big_case.notes: A single capital stay application on the eve of an Oklahoma execution, from a successive state post-conviction proceeding the state court resolved on a procedural bar. The question (extending the Pena-Rodriguez juror-impeachment exception to alleged false prosecutorial argument) is novel but drew no amicus, no noted dissent and no separate writing; the Court denied the stay and certiorari in a two-sentence order. Grave for the applicant, low systemic significance.
